label: code speed on this machine, not a real-time guarantee on hardware
method: 4 alternating runs, one rollout each, separate processes, same session. before = commit 3ce1c3e (scalar detector, exact lidar), after = batched detector plus fast lidar
noise_note: the same rollout varied from 3.6 s to 8.9 s within one session on this 4-core laptop; earlier single figures (22.3 s before, 3.9 s after) came from different thermal states and are not comparable
regression: e1 no-control dev baseline: counts and per-run final hashes identical on all 90 runs

parallel_variants.note: 4 physical cores; workers slow each other down (13 s per job against 4.5 s alone)
